verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents per-sync observability. A sync maps one model to one destination, so this is effectively per destination. Each run reports its outcome, a sync debugger lets you inspect runs and rejected rows, and configurable sync alerts notify you when a run fails; a company comment on HN also cites a 'live debugger' and alerting. There is no evidence of a live view of events flowing through the Events pipeline, and delivery metrics are only implied by per-run outcome reporting. Missing for 10: live event-stream debugger for Hightouch Events, documented delivery metrics/dashboards per destination, detailed debugger docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
